dedupe_keys.name: national performance report water and wastewater service providers australia

description: The National Performance Report is Australia's annual benchmarking of urban water and wastewater service providers. The Bureau of Meteorology prepares it independently with State and Territory governments and the Water Services Association of Australia, under commitments of the National Water Initiative. The 2024-25 edition covers 143 performance indicators from about 300 entities, including bulk water authorities, water utilities and councils, on water resources supply and use, finance and pricing, assets and operations, customer service, greenhouse gas emissions and public health and environmental compliance. Coverage is national by provider and reporting region, one value per financial year, with reports online back to before 2013-14. Part A is a PDF report with analysis, major urban centre comparisons and appendices on providers, indicators and audit; Part B is the complete dataset as a 12 MB Excel file, supported by an indicators and definitions handbook. Access is free download; the Bureau's copyright page gives Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 for most content while noting not all content is licensed the same way. Caveats: smaller providers report under lighter guidance, indicator definitions changed with the 2023 framework, and data are self-reported and audited to varying degrees. Simulation uses: calibrating demand, leakage, asset condition and cost parameters for Australian water and sewer models and benchmarking resilience and capacity planning. Related records: the US Clean Watersheds Needs Survey (data-epa-clean-watersheds-needs-survey-2022) and Brazil's SNIS (data-brazil-snis-sanitation-information-system) are comparable national data sets.
